verdict.rationale: Adyen's Disputes API (docs-23) confirms merchants can retrieve dispute information, defend/accept disputes, and upload defense evidence documents, and webhooks (docs-14, docs-21) provide the mechanism to be notified of async status changes such as chargebacks. However, there is no explicit documentation of chargeback-specific notification (e.g., a dedicated dispute-opened webhook event) or explicit deadline tracking/alerts, and no dashboard/Customer Area screenshots or independent confirmation of the dispute workflow in practice. missing for 10: explicit chargeback/dispute webhook event documentation, deadline-alerting features, and independent/hands-on validation of the dispute submission flow.
